direct_findings.statement: 2025 Gold Rush umbrella distinguishes bills, scheduled payments, escrow, cash received and seized assets.
Original EDNY indictment alleges more than30 suppliers and common billing, registration, courier and pass-through arrangements; unnamed vendors remain placeholders.
CMS reported revoking fifteen unnamed recently transferred suppliers and stopping over99% of their payments.
GAO identified supplemental-payment exposure and documented suspension reports beginning December2025/January2026; total private-payer cash remains unknown.
direct_findings.locator: section CMS Has Begun to Inform Supplemental Payers of Payment Suspensions

direct_findings.statement: DOJ expressly links Centennial and ND Medical cases to the Gold Rush organization. Claim-level inclusion in the 2025 aggregate remains unverified.
Centennial indictment provides distinct billed, Medicare-paid and supplemental-paid totals.
Bendeliani allegedly became sole officer/manager June20,2025 and sole signatory at six institutions; registration status is distinct from alleged concealed control.
Centennial claims data showing $1.2bn paid largely represented escrow after June30,2025 suspension; the suspension did not itself cover private insurers.
Centennial had two unnamed DME counterparties whose transfer purpose remained under investigation.
Affidavit documents CHAMPVA claims; the cited amount is billing, not payment.
Danelia allegedly assisted account opening and transfers; overseas wires differ from insurer receipts.
direct_findings.locator: Danelia case bullet; affidavit p18 paragraph49

direct_findings.statement: ND Medical indictment separates billed claims from Medicare and other-insurer cash.
Gugava purportedly owned ND Medical from February18 through July9,2025; underlying beneficial control remains alleged.
Gugava was indicted September3,2026 on one count of money laundering conspiracy; no disposition beyond that established here.
CMS precluded eleven unnamed 2025–26 suppliers; four had moved from revoked Original Medicare billing to Medicare Advantage.
OIG identifies ownership verification, ordering-document and beneficiary-identifier weaknesses; these are control risks, not proof against an uncharged supplier.
Earlier catheter audit estimated improper payments; documentation deficiencies do not themselves establish deliberate fraud.
Renat Abramov pleaded guilty February3,2026 and was sentenced August11,2026 to18months for money laundering conspiracy.

amounts.period: convicted conduct; source does not state complete range

direct_findings.statement: Elnar Zarbailov was sentenced May18,2026 to37months; forfeiture was ordered, not verified collected.
Eldar Zarbavel pleaded guilty August13,2026. DOJ named Royce Medical Supply LLC and scheduled sentencing for December16.
DOJ reported35 charged and16 convicted in Gold Rush as of August14,2026; this is not an October census.
